Create a performance review template for evaluating [role title] at my company. Review period: [quarterly / semi-annual / annual].
Sections: (1) Role overview and key responsibilities, (2) Rating scale (suggest a good one — not just 1-5, something with clear descriptors), (3) Performance evaluation by key competency — include [list 4-6 competencies relevant to the role, e.g., "quality of work, communication, initiative, meeting deadlines, collaboration, technical skill"], (4) Goals from last review period — met/partially met/not met (with space for context), (5) Key accomplishments this period, (6) Areas for improvement (be specific — suggest how to phrase constructive feedback without being vague or demoralizing), (7) Goals for next period (SMART format), (8) Employee self-assessment questions, (9) Overall rating and summary. Make this a tool that drives actual development, not a box-checking exercise.
